analysis.is_complaint_reason: Customer expresses dissatisfaction that a mortgage direct debit of £1,240 was taken twice, causing an overdraft of £900 and potential charges (CH-1: financial loss).
analysis.summary: Customer says the mortgage direct debit of £1,240 was collected twice on 3 November, leaving the account £900 overdrawn. She cites social media reports of other customers affected. The handler confirmed a duplicate collection linked to open Digital Ops incident INC-4602, affecting approx 3,100 customers. Customer wants the money back today and overdraft charges cancelled. No vulnerability indicators found; customer was asked. Prefers email.

timeline.event: Mortgage direct debit of £1,240 collected twice; account became £900 overdrawn
Handler confirmed duplicate DD collection; incident INC-4602 open, approx 3,100 customers affected; statement saved

analysis.severity_reason: Potential systemic issue affecting many customers (approx 3,100 per INC-4602) under CH-6. Direct loss of £1,240 from the duplicate also exceeds £1,000.

vulnerability.suggested_support: None identified. Keep under review given the overdraft; offer support if financial difficulty emerges.

analysis.routing_reason: ESC-1: a suspected systemic issue, the same fault affecting many customers, goes to Senior Complaints Review. The duplicate collection is a systems failure needing technical investigation, so Digital Operations is also needed. Senior Complaints Review is primary because of the scale.

policy_citations.quote: a potential systemic issue affecting many customers
policy_citations.how_it_applies: Incident INC-4602 shows approx 3,100 customers affected, so severity is High.

policy_citations.quote: A suspected systemic issue (the same fault affecting many customers), a threat of legal action, or media contact → *Senior Complaints Review*.
policy_citations.how_it_applies: The same duplicate DD fault affects many customers.

policy_citations.quote: A systems or app failure that needs technical investigation → *Digital Operations*.
policy_citations.how_it_applies: The duplicate collection is tied to an open Digital Ops incident.

policy_citations.quote: Decisions on whether a complaint is upheld, and on any redress, must be made by an authorised complaints handler or specialist.
policy_citations.how_it_applies: Refund and overdraft charge decisions are for an authorised person, not this tool.

evidence.quote: Your bank took my mortgage direct debit of £1,240 TWICE on 3 November.
I want the money back today and the overdraft charges cancelled.
